---
id: collab-01
title: "Disagreeing with an engineer"
minutes: 8
tier: core
competencies: [collaboration]
---

## Ask

Tell me about a time an engineer said your design could not be built as drawn. What did you do?

## Look for

### associate

- Describes what the engineer said, in their own words

### designer

- Names what they changed, and what they held firm on
- Says how they checked the new version with the engineer

### senior

- Proposes a way the team could surface such limits earlier

## Follow-ups

- What would you ask them earlier next time?
- What did you give up?
